title: Absolute icon paths in desktop files are ignored when icon is displayed in KRunner and Kickoff/kicker/dashboard/etc
line: Apps whose desktop file points to an icon file by full path now show that file in Kickoff and KRunner instead of a theme icon with the same name.
explanation: Kickoff and KRunner pass the desktop file's Icon= string to Kirigami.Icon, which makes a KIconEngine icon from it. When Plasma's Kirigami theme is active, Kirigami re-loads the icon through the theme by QIcon::name(), and KIconEngine::iconName() returned only the file's base name for absolute paths ("hwinfo" for /path/hwinfo.svg), so the theme's icon of that name won. iconName() now returns absolute paths unchanged, so the re-load uses the file itself. Task Manager was unaffected because it doesn't go through this re-load.

commits.message:
KIconEngine: return absolute paths unchanged from iconName()

For an icon made from an absolute file path, iconName() returned only the
file's base name, so Kirigami looked that name up in the icon theme and
Kickoff and KRunner showed a theme icon instead of the file. Keep the path.

BUG: 496178

media.caption: Kickoff: TestApp with Icon=/home/kdetest2/hwinfo.svg (a copy of Kate's icon) shows Breeze's hwinfo icon
Kickoff: the same entry shows the Kate icon from the file
KRunner: same entry shows Breeze's hwinfo icon
KRunner: the same entry shows the file's Kate icon

review.text: The root cause diagnosis and repo placement in kiconthemes (KIconEngine::iconName()) are spot-on, and the before/after screenshots clearly verify the fix in both Kickoff and KRunner. However, returning mIconName for absolute paths before calling preferredIconPath(mIconName) bypasses the existence check (if (iconPath.isEmpty()) return QString();), causing iconName() to return a non-empty string even for non-existent absolute file paths. Move the absolute-path check after the iconPath.isEmpty() guard and add a unit test in kiconthemes.
changes: In KIconEngine::iconName(), move the QDir::isAbsolutePath(mIconName) check after the preferredIconPath(mIconName) lookup and its iconPath.isEmpty() guard (returning iconPath) so non-existent absolute paths still return an empty QString().

Add unit test coverage in kiconthemes's autotests (e.g. kiconengine_unittest.cpp) verifying KIconEngine::iconName() returns the full path for an existing absolute icon file and an empty string for a non-existent absolute path.
